title: Close to Broadway w/ Rooftop Deck + Skyline View!
description:
✓ Top 1% airbnb in Nashville
The avg Airbnb rating in Nashville is 4.80 stars. Now look at this Airbnb's rating. You can trust you've found a great one.

✓ Close to Broadway and restaurants 
Just 2.3 miles from Broadway in trendy East Nashville, my place is next door to great food, drinks, and coffee.

✓ Post-worthy design. Nap worthy comfort.
Trendy design that's also comfortable! I've taken the small things that make a stay smooth into account just for you!

The space
✓ 3 floors of comfort and games
✓ Restaurants, coffee, and grocery nearby
✓ Downtown skyline view
✓ High-speed Wi-Fi + free parking

✗ No elevator (stairs only). 

• 1st floor: sofa bed (qn), half bath, kitchen, living room w/ games
• 2nd floor: master bedroom (king) with en suite full bath
• 2nd floor: bunk bedroom (qn over qn) with detached full bath
• 3rd floor: rooftop deck with skyline view and ring game + dry bar

**Showers are on the 2nd floor only, so please do not book if an elevator is a requirement.**

Guest access
You will have access to the entire condo via a smart lock keypad.
